data.action: 吓得扑抱进对方怀中，双手紧抓胸口衣襟，眼含泪花脸埋肩膀，呆毛剧颤
data.camera: medium close-up, three-quarter side view, both people and the grip on Masaomi’s shirt visible
data.description: 傍晚昏暗静寂的神社后山小径旁，古老的石灯笼在落日阴影中透着丝丝凉意。远处一阵怪异的树影摇曳，把身为刀灵的丛雨吓得发出一声娇呼，整个人猛地扑入将臣怀中。两只小手死死揪住将臣胸口的衣服不放，泪眼汪汪、眼眶微红地把小脸埋在将臣肩窝——「呜哇啊啊！刚才那里有可疑的白影动了一下！我辈才没有害怕……只是借汝的肩膀避一避啦！」
data.lighting: cool purple dusk from residual sunset and faint stone-lantern light
data.location: 神社后山黄昏古树石阶小路
data.promptProse: Startled by tree shadows, Murasame in her frilled spirit kimono grabs Masaomi's cream shirt with both hands and hides against his shoulder. Her long green hair and red ribbons fall across his chest. He turns toward her in profile, his short dark hair lit along the edge by the stone lantern.
data.title: 丛雨 · 怕鬼刀灵的投怀送抱
data.animaCaption: Murasame presses her green-haired head into Masaomi's shoulder, clutching his shirt with both hands. His short dark hair and plain cream shirt show in three-quarter profile as he catches her beside the lantern.
